title: To Alice Arbuthnot Moberly

It is a great relief to-day to hear of the operation being over.[^1] I am so glad [Dr.

Moberly](/person/1015) was able to be there. I have been wishing to see [Mr.

Keble](/person/798) to hear how [you](/person/1025) were all looking in Oxford, but we have not been able to go to Hursley. [Johnnie](/person/1017)'s wig is very shaggy, but we agree that he is growing very handsome. . . .


[^1]: The operation on [George Moberly](/person/1014) the younger.
